source: Daily report #100 was a silent day with no explicit next-step suggestions. Pipeline performed its own audit: (1) ran targeted jest suites, (2) grep-audited recent fix commits (2abfffc, e819dfa, c6d9106) for test coverage gaps.

suggestions.title: Fix broken dsh-bridge.service.spec.ts (regression from c6d9106)
suggestions.rationale: Suite FAILS to compile: DshBridgeService constructor gained a VoiceService param (commit c6d9106, TTS narration) but spec still calls new DshBridgeService(); buildInput gained a 3rd narrationSrcPaths param. jest run produces TS2554 errors — this suite is red on every full run.
suggestions.evidence: npx jest --testPathPattern='unit/dsh-bridge' → 'Expected 1 arguments, but got 0' (TS2554) at spec lines 8/18

suggestions.title: Add unit tests for LessonContentService.completeStep video_lesson watch fallback
suggestions.rationale: Commit 2abfffc added a fallback: content without steps array + stepId='watch' + has videoLesson/visualStory/scenes → synthetic {id:'watch'} step instead of NotFoundException. Zero test coverage — existing spec only covers modifyDraft.
suggestions.evidence: grep completeStep/videoLesson in test/unit/lesson-content.service.spec.ts → only modifyDraft watch-scene sync tests, no completeStep coverage

suggestions.title: Add unit test for buildPackPayloadFromContent video_lesson branch
suggestions.rationale: Commit e819dfa added a video_lesson format branch (lesson.videoLesson/visualStory without steps → passthrough payload). Existing spec only exercises the structured-lesson steps branch (regex scan of all buildPackPayloadFromContent calls: steps=True only).
suggestions.evidence: python regex scan: 1 call site in spec, always with steps array present; no test where content has videoLesson but no steps
